interpretation.note_on_l1_comparison: L1 mAP50=0.766 was measured on its training set (DEVELOPMENT = 38 V1 frames, no holdout). D2 val/holdout are genuinely unseen. The comparison is not apples-to-apples. D2 holdout recall=0.630 is meaningful; L1 recall on Paris canary was 0.000.
interpretation.precision_analysis: Precision near 0 across all splits. Model detects persons broadly but does not discriminate diver vs background people. Primary cause: 32 training frames is insufficient for high-precision single-class fine-tuning on a visually diverse corpus.
interpretation.usability_verdict: MARGINAL — recall sufficient for tracking input, precision requires NMS + scene prior filtering
